svg.title: Recurrent mass-shift scouting
svg.desc: Two related synthetic MS2 spectra: strongest peaks, shared coarse bins, unchanged and shifted fragment matches, and the accepted neutral mass difference; then a recurrent mass-shift family, isotope and adduct check, and tight UniMod mass-compatible lookup. Mass compatibility is not identity.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Scouting recurrent mass shifts without identifications

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Synthetic spectra scored with prideQC's own mass-shift code. The scout looks for related spectra whose precursor masses differ by a recurring amount.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: recurrence window = max(0.01, 6 × √2 × σ_ppm × M / 10⁶) = 0.036 Da (σ_ppm = 2.5 from mass-error precision; representative M = 1700 Da).

svg.text: Several distinct entries can fit one mass window (here two biological PTMs). No peptide sequence is identified; no site is localized.

text.font-family: Arial, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, 'Liberation Sans', 'Nimbus Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Fixed modifications with no unmodified partner spectrum can be invisible to a pair-based scout.
